entries.clue: Ghostly-bright guardian summoned by a single happy memory
Unlocking charm that opens a door without need of a key
Derby winner of 1981, kidnapped from an Irish stud and never found
Selfish keeper of the best bits; also a castrated male pig
Spectral black hound in the tea leaves, an omen of death
Fattier joint than the leg, tender enough to pull into strands with a fork
Wild birds or deer, hung before cooking; also a round of cards
Celtic horse goddess honoured by Roman cavalry; also Link's loyal steed in Zelda games
Wealthy pure-blood family of a Wiltshire manor house
Bowl pierced all over with holes, tipped in the sink to drain the veg
Smooth-paced riding animal of a medieval lady, no beast of war
Knotted string bag of forage, tied high so it cannot be trodden on
